responsibility: Implements lowering of individual struct-expression fields during struct literal construction. It compiles explicit value fields directly and resolves shorthand identifier fields by synthesizing a path expression and reusing normal expression/path lowering, providing the field-value side of struct constructor assembly without handling the full struct expression itself.
same_name_distinction: Implements compilation of the different struct field expression forms. Unlike rust-compile-struct-field-expr.h, it contains the executable logic for compiling explicit field values and for rewriting shorthand fields into synthetic path expressions before normal expression lowering.
